_readme: S740 (the census's reconcile_steps lever, lane 1 `reconcile`): the catalog's own words for a correction step, read as the capture reads the page (capture_view), free, no model call, nothing written. Norco: five curriQunet program pages whose filed records add short of the printed total by the units of a required row the reading did not hold (Philosophy A.A.-T prints 'Units: 9.00' over two choices of 3); this read prints each page as the capture reads it, so the session sees whether the text holds the row.

questions.required_rows: Which rows does the page print under Required Courses, and which figure over them?
